title: Operations Control + Exception Dashboard
businessRequirement: Build a centralized Operations Control + Exception Dashboard using existing approved ANCLINE data to surface action-required jobs, cut-off risks, missing carrier references, document gaps, payment/release blocks, failed integration/retry events, overdue milestones, NVOCC/Forwarding exceptions, and finance/reconciliation exceptions, with direct links back to the affected job or action.
objective: Improve day-to-day operational visibility and exception handling without redesigning or replacing approved transactional workflows.

impactAssessment.web: REQUIRED — new dashboard UI, filters, exception cards/grids, direct action links, role-aware visibility.
impactAssessment.api: REQUIRED — consolidated exception/query endpoints or aggregation layer are likely needed for reliable cross-module status calculation.
impactAssessment.shared: REQUIRED — dashboard combines operational, finance, document, milestone, release, and integration state.
impactAssessment.dataMigration: NOT_EXPECTED — use existing approved schema/data first; schema change prohibited unless proven necessary during implementation.
impactAssessment.securityPrivacy: HIGH_IMPORTANCE — preserve role scope and customer/agent/carrier privacy; do not expose internal/KYC data.
impactAssessment.financeReleaseControls: HIGH_IMPORTANCE — dashboard may surface blockers/status but must not bypass payment/release approval logic.

regressionPlan.rule: Populate automatically from approved component scope before build.

notes: RECOMMENDED CHANGE DEFINED. Scope is SHARED because reliable exception computation spans Web and API. Build/deploy/promotion remain blocked until explicit approval. Implementation should prefer read-only aggregation over new write paths and must preserve current transactional controls.
